overrides.value: Adds a Save Sentence button to the reader's text selection popup, which sends the selected text and the document's title to a server that must be running at 127.0.0.1:5000.
overrides.reason: Condensed from the code of src/modules/popup.ts, since README.md is the unchanged plugin template text. The manifest description, "Zotero Excerpt", only repeats the name, and the GitHub About text is missing.
